items.title: Is Imperial Brands (LSE:IMB) Cheap After Takeover Talk And Cost Cuts?
items.summary: Imperial Brands has seen its stock rise over the past few years, helped recently by takeover speculation and cost cutting plans. This naturally raises a question for anyone looking at the shares today: Is the current price grounded in the cash flows the business is expected to produce, or is it leaning more on corporate interest and sentiment around the sector?
